title: Professor X
subtitle: Charles Xavier: the dream, the secrets, and the consequences.
intro: Xavier is usually best understood through team stories. New X-Men is a modern entrance; Legacy is the more focused character study, but its opening collections could not be confirmed in this catalog.

herald.label: Comic Book Herald · Professor X essentials

legacy.label: Marvel · Divided He Stands contents and focus

stories.title: Xavier & Magneto’s first meeting
stories.why: A key look at Charles’s past and his relationship with Magneto.
stories.match: Uncanny Masterworks Vol. 8 includes #161–167. Read the #161 flashback here; the collection also continues the broader team story.

stories.title: E Is for Extinction
stories.why: A modern team relaunch that changes Xavier’s public role.
stories.match: The dedicated Vol. 1 contains #114–117 and the 2001 annual. The larger E Is for Extinction Epic is an alternative covering more issues.

stories.title: Deadly Genesis
stories.why: A major reassessment of Xavier’s decisions. Read after some classic X-Men context.
stories.match: No confirmed matching collection in the supplied catalog. This is the six-issue Brubaker series, not a generic origin collection.

stories.title: Legacy: Divided He Stands
stories.why: A Xavier-centered recovery and reflection story following Messiah Complex.
stories.match: No confirmed match for this opening Legacy collection. The catalog’s Lost Legions and Five Miles South of the Universe are later arcs and do not replace it.

stories.title: Life of X & A Man Called X
stories.why: A pivotal Xavier return, best with earlier familiarity.
stories.match: Read Life of X (#1–6), then A Man Called X (#7–12). These are consecutive volumes, not alternative editions.

stories.title: House of X / Powers of X
stories.issues: House of X (2019) #1–6; Powers of X (2019) #1–6
stories.why: Xavier helps launch a new mutant status quo.
stories.match: The combined collection supplies the interleaved twelve-part reading order. X-Men ’92: House of XCII is a different version.
